faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our service

questions.question: How do I get a Gemini API key?
questions.answer: You need to sign up for Google AI Studio and get a free API key. The key lets you use Google's AI services. Just go to the Google AI Studio website, create an account, and generate a new API key.

questions.question: What is the maximum file size I can upload?
questions.answer: We currently support files up to 3.5GB and up to 3 hours long. If you have a larger file, you can compress it with video compression software or contact us for a custom solution. We're working on raising these limits in the future.

questions.question: How long does it take to create a recap?
questions.answer: Processing time depends on the length of the original video and the requested recap length. The process usually takes between 2-15 minutes. A one-hour video is typically processed in about 8 minutes, and a two-hour video can take up to 15 minutes.

questions.question: Is my information secure?
questions.answer: Yes, we use advanced encryption and never store your API keys. All files are automatically deleted after processing. We take user privacy and data security very seriously, following international standards.

questions.question: Which video formats are supported?
questions.answer: We support the most common formats: MP4, AVI, MOV, and MKV. These cover most videos produced today. If you have a file in another format, you can convert it using free online tools.

questions.question: Can I edit the recap after it's created?
questions.answer: Currently the recap is generated automatically based on the settings you chose. We're working on advanced editing features that will allow personal customization of the recap, including replacing segments and adjusting the text.

questions.question: What happens if there's a problem processing the video?
questions.answer: In case of an error, the system will notify you immediately and suggest solutions. Common errors are related to file size or an unsupported format. Our team is available for technical support with any issue.

questions.question: Is the service free?
questions.answer: The basic service is available for free with certain limits. You use your own API key, so costs depend on your own usage of Google Gemini. We also have advanced plans for professional users.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.body: At Movies & TV Recaps Maker Hub ("the Service") we are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.

privacyPage.videoFilesBody: The video files you upload are processed directly in your browser using FFmpeg.wasm. They are never stored on our servers and are cleared from the browser's memory once processing finishes or the page is refreshed.
privacyPage.apiKeyBody: Your API key is sent directly from your browser to Google's Gemini services. It is never stored on our servers at any stage.
privacyPage.anonStatsBody: We collect fully anonymous data to improve the service. This data includes:
anonStatsList: Count of ratings and the sum of ratings.
Count of unique visitors (using a random, anonymous identifier stored only in your browser).
privacyPage.howWeUseHeading: 3. How do we use the information?
privacyPage.howWeUseIntro: The information collected is used solely for the following purposes:
howWeUseList: To provide you with the Service's functionality (video processing and script generation).
To improve the Service and anonymously analyze how it is used.
privacyPage.securityBody: We take reasonable security measures to protect your information. However, it's important to remember that no system is 100% secure. Responsibility for safeguarding your API key rests with you.
privacyPage.thirdPartyBody: The Service uses third-party services, including Google Gemini. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies to understand how they handle information.
privacyPage.changesBody: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will post any changes on this page.
